name: t23-g3-impaired-join
description: T23 / G3 row 10. Three live clients drive the two-region collapse on the bounded world and converge with the server; the run then reaches body-settle quiescence and the server shuts down. Client 3 is a --late-join replica whose connect is delayed until well after that shutdown, so its baseline transfer cannot complete. With late_join_may_fail set, the run passes when the late joiner terminates in a bounded explicit failure (a `join-failed` summary and a real process exit, code 4 - not a hang, not a silent partial state) while the live clients and server still agree on one canonical topology hash and the committed stream still replays to it. The complementary 'join succeeds' half of the requirement is fixtures/scenarios/t23-g3.json.
